task.title: Add per-project skill install overrides
task.description: Add --skill-dir and --no-skill flags to workbook setup and every workbook docs subcommand as a stopgap until per-project configuration lands with WB-01KYQPKSGAMTB9TQZEV17RGY55. skillDir is currently readable only from user-global configuration, so one value decides where the skill lands in every repository on a machine, and there is no way to skip installing the skill without also skipping the guidelines.
